_comment: Original IELTS Speaking practice packs for IELTS Vocabulary Master (CC BY-SA 4.0). Questions are typical IELTS-style prompts written for this app; sample answers are original. 'vocab' lists headwords that are linked to dictionary entries when present.

packs.title: Hometown
questions: Where is your hometown?
What do you like most about your hometown?
Has your hometown changed much in recent years?
Would you like to live there in the future?
packs.sample: I grew up in Da Nang, a coastal city in central Vietnam. What I love most is that it combines the hustle and bustle of a modern city with beautiful beaches, so you can enjoy some peace and quiet just a few minutes from the centre. It has changed a lot recently – there are many new bridges and high-rise buildings, and the infrastructure has improved considerably.
packs.tips_vi: Trả lời 2–3 câu, mở rộng bằng lý do hoặc ví dụ. Dùng thì hiện tại hoàn thành khi nói về thay đổi (has changed, have built).

packs.title: Work or Study
questions: Do you work or are you a student?
Why did you choose that job or subject?
What do you find most challenging about it?
What would you like to do in the future?
packs.sample: I'm currently a third-year student majoring in economics. I chose it because I've always been interested in how markets work, and it should give me a wide range of career options. The most challenging part is the heavy workload – I often have to stay up late to meet deadlines – but it's very rewarding.
packs.tips_vi: Đừng chỉ nói 'I'm a student'. Thêm chuyên ngành, lý do chọn và một chi tiết cá nhân.

packs.title: Free Time & Hobbies
questions: What do you usually do in your free time?
Did you have the same hobbies as a child?
Do you prefer spending free time alone or with others?
Is there a new hobby you would like to try?
vocab: step out of my comfort zone
packs.sample: To be honest, I'm really into photography at the moment. After a busy week, I like to unwind by walking around the old quarter and taking pictures of street life. As a child I was more of a football person, but my interests have changed. I'd love to try rock climbing one day – it would definitely get me out of my comfort zone.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng các cụm tự nhiên như 'I'm really into…', 'to unwind' thay cho 'I like…' lặp đi lặp lại.

packs.title: Food & Cooking
questions: What kind of food do you like?
Do you often cook at home?
Is there any food you disliked as a child?
Do you think people eat more healthily now than in the past?
packs.sample: I'm a big fan of Vietnamese street food, especially noodle soups, which are absolutely mouth-watering. I try to cook from scratch at home a few times a week because it's cheaper and healthier than takeaways. I'd say people are more aware of nutrition now, but busy lifestyles mean many still rely on junk food.
packs.tips_vi: Khi nói về món ăn, dùng tính từ miêu tả hương vị: savoury, spicy, bland, rich.

packs.title: Technology & Phones
questions: How often do you use your phone?
What apps do you use most?
Could you live without your phone for a week?
Did you use technology much as a child?
packs.sample: Honestly, I'm on my phone for several hours a day, mostly for messaging apps and studying. I use a dictionary app a lot because it's very user-friendly. I don't think I could live without it for a week, as it's how I keep in touch with my family. When I was a child, though, I spent much more time playing outdoors.
packs.tips_vi: So sánh quá khứ – hiện tại bằng 'used to', 'when I was a child', 'these days'.

packs.title: Travel & Holidays
questions: Do you like travelling?
Where did you go on your last holiday?
Do you prefer travelling alone or in a group?
What kind of places would you like to visit?
vocab: on the spur of the moment
packs.sample: Yes, I love travelling because it really broadens my horizons. Last summer I went to Ha Giang with some friends – the mountain scenery was absolutely breathtaking. I prefer places off the beaten track rather than crowded tourist spots, and I usually plan a rough itinerary but leave room for decisions made on the spur of the moment.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng thì quá khứ đơn cho chuyến đi đã qua; thêm tính từ mạnh (breathtaking, stunning).

packs.title: Reading
questions: Do you like reading?
What kind of books do you enjoy?
Do you prefer printed books or e-books?
Did your parents read to you as a child?
packs.sample: I do, although I don't read as much as I'd like to. I'm a big fan of science fiction, and I also read non-fiction to acquire knowledge about history. I prefer printed books because I spend enough time staring at screens. I vividly remember my mother reading fairy tales to me every night.
packs.tips_vi: Có thể dùng 'although' để thêm sự tương phản, giúp câu trả lời tự nhiên hơn.

packs.title: Weather & Seasons
questions: What's the weather like where you live?
What is your favourite season?
Does the weather affect your mood?
Has the weather changed in your country?
packs.sample: Where I live, the summers are scorching and humid, and we get heavy rain in the autumn. My favourite season is spring because the weather is mild. Gloomy days can make me feel a bit down in the dumps. I think climate change is real – heatwaves seem to be longer than when I was young.
packs.tips_vi: Tránh 'strong rain' – dùng 'heavy rain'. Dùng 'scorching' cho trời rất nóng.

packs.title: Friends
questions: Do you have many friends?
How do you usually spend time with your friends?
Is it easy to make friends where you live?
Are online friends as important as real-life friends?
packs.sample: I wouldn't say I have a lot of friends, but I have a few close friends I get on really well with. We usually hang out at a café or catch up over dinner. It's fairly easy to make friends at university, but keeping in touch after graduation is harder. Online friends are nice, but I think trust is built face to face.
packs.tips_vi: Phân biệt 'friend', 'close friend', 'acquaintance' (người quen) để tăng độ chính xác từ vựng.

packs.title: Music
questions: What kind of music do you like?
When do you usually listen to music?
Can you play a musical instrument?
Have your music tastes changed over time?
packs.sample: I listen to all sorts of genres, but I'm a big fan of acoustic pop with meaningful lyrics. I usually put my headphones on during my commute or to unwind before bed. I learned the guitar for a year, but I'm not very good. My tastes have definitely changed – as a teenager I only liked catchy pop songs.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng 'all sorts of' để nói đa dạng; 'during my commute' = trên đường đi làm/học.

packs.title: Describe a person who has influenced you
packs.title_vi: Mô tả một người đã ảnh hưởng đến bạn
questions: Who this person is
How you know this person
What this person has done
And explain why this person has influenced you
packs.sample: I'd like to talk about my grandfather, who I've always looked up to. He was a primary school teacher in a small village for over thirty years. Despite earning very little, he set an example of hard work and kindness. He taught me that education can change people's lives, which was a turning point for me – it's the reason I decided to study teaching. I'll never forget the way he listened patiently to every child.
packs.tips_vi: Part 2: chuẩn bị 1 phút, nói 1–2 phút. Bám theo 4 gạch đầu dòng; kết thúc bằng phần 'explain why' – phần ghi điểm.

packs.title: Describe a place you visited that you found beautiful
packs.title_vi: Mô tả một nơi đẹp bạn từng đến
questions: Where it is
When you went there
What you did there
And explain why you found it beautiful
packs.sample: I'm going to describe Ban Gioc Waterfall, which is in the far north of Vietnam near the Chinese border. I went there two years ago with my cousins. It's quite off the beaten track, so it wasn't too crowded. We took a bamboo raft close to the falls and then hiked up a hill for a panoramic view. The scenery was absolutely breathtaking – layers of white water against green mountains. It was a once-in-a-lifetime experience because it felt so unspoilt and tranquil.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng nhiều tính từ miêu tả cảm giác và hình ảnh; dùng thì quá khứ đơn cho trải nghiệm.

packs.title: Describe a piece of technology you find useful
packs.title_vi: Mô tả một thiết bị công nghệ hữu ích
questions: What it is
When you got it
How you use it
And explain why you find it useful
packs.sample: The piece of technology I'd like to talk about is my laptop. I bought it when I started university, and it was a big investment for me. I use it for almost everything – writing assignments, attending online classes and editing photos. It's incredibly portable and user-friendly, and the battery life is excellent. I honestly can't live without it, as it has made me far more productive.
packs.tips_vi: Nói về cách sử dụng cụ thể (for writing, for attending…) giúp bài nói chi tiết.

packs.title: Describe a time you achieved something difficult
packs.title_vi: Mô tả lần bạn đạt được điều khó khăn
questions: What you achieved
When it happened
Why it was difficult
And explain how you felt about it
vocab: step out of my comfort zone
packs.sample: I'd like to talk about completing my first half-marathon last year. It was difficult because I had never been a sporty person, and I had a knee injury halfway through my training. However, I was determined to persevere, so I adjusted my plan and trained more carefully. When I crossed the finish line, I was over the moon. It gave me a real sense of achievement and showed me that hard work pays off.
packs.tips_vi: Kể chuyện theo trình tự: bối cảnh → khó khăn → cách vượt qua → cảm xúc.

packs.title: Describe a skill you would like to learn
packs.title_vi: Mô tả một kỹ năng bạn muốn học
questions: What the skill is
How you would learn it
How long it would take
And explain why you want to learn it
packs.sample: One skill I'd really like to learn is cooking traditional dishes from scratch. I'd probably start with online tutorials and then take a short course with a professional instructor. I imagine it would take a few months to get the hang of the basic techniques. I want to learn it because it would help me eat more healthily, and I'd love to keep my family's recipes alive.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng câu điều kiện loại 2 (would, could) khi nói về điều chưa xảy ra.

packs.title: Describe a film or book that made you think
packs.title_vi: Mô tả một bộ phim/cuốn sách khiến bạn suy nghĩ
questions: What it was
When you watched or read it
What it was about
And explain why it made you think
packs.sample: I'd like to describe a documentary about plastic pollution in the ocean that I watched last year. It followed a team of scientists who discovered huge amounts of plastic in remote seas. It was really thought-provoking because it portrayed how our daily habits affect wildlife thousands of kilometres away. Since watching it, I've cut down on single-use plastic. I'd say it's highly recommended for anyone.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng 'thought-provoking', 'moving', 'portray' để nói về nội dung và tác động.

packs.title: Describe a time you helped someone
packs.title_vi: Mô tả lần bạn giúp đỡ ai đó
questions: Who you helped
How you helped them
Why you helped them
And explain how you felt about it
packs.sample: Last winter I volunteered at a charity that distributes warm clothes to children in mountainous areas. My job was to sort donations and help hand them out. I did it because I believe small actions can make a difference. Seeing the children's smiles was incredibly rewarding, and the experience made me more grateful for what I have.
packs.tips_vi: Kết thúc bằng cảm xúc và bài học rút ra để phần 'explain' trọn vẹn.

packs.title: Education & Learning
questions: Should university education be free?
How has technology changed the way people learn?
Is it better to learn practical skills or academic knowledge?
What makes a good teacher?
packs.sample: That's a tricky question. On the one hand, free higher education would give equal opportunities to students from poorer families and help bridge the gap between rich and poor. On the other hand, someone has to pay for it, usually taxpayers. To some extent, I think a compromise – free tuition for low-income students – would be the most practical solution.
packs.tips_vi: Part 3: trả lời dài hơn (4–6 câu), nêu hai mặt, đưa ví dụ và quan điểm cá nhân.

packs.title: Environment & Responsibility
questions: Who should be responsible for protecting the environment – individuals or governments?
Why do some people not care about environmental problems?
Will renewable energy replace fossil fuels?
How can cities become greener?
packs.sample: I believe it's a shared responsibility. Individuals can reduce their carbon footprint by recycling and using public transport, but the biggest changes have to happen on a global scale. Governments need to impose strict regulations on polluting industries and invest in renewable energy. In the long run, I think renewables will replace fossil fuels, although the transition will take decades.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng 'I believe it's a shared responsibility' rồi phân tích vai trò từng bên.

packs.title: Technology & Society
questions: Has technology made people more isolated?
Will artificial intelligence replace many jobs?
Should children's screen time be limited?
What are the risks of sharing personal data online?
packs.sample: In my opinion, technology is a double-edged sword. It's undeniable that it helps us keep in touch with people far away, but many people are now glued to their screens instead of talking face to face. As for AI, I think it will displace some routine jobs, but it will also create new roles that we can't imagine yet.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng 'As for…' để chuyển ý; 'a double-edged sword' phù hợp hơn trong Speaking.

packs.title: Work & Careers
questions: Is job satisfaction more important than salary?
Will more people work from home in the future?
Why do some people change careers?
What skills will be important in the future?
packs.sample: For most people, a decent salary comes first because they need to make a living. However, once basic needs are met, job satisfaction becomes more important – people want meaningful work and a good work-life balance. I think a growing number of people will work remotely, at least part of the week, because it saves commuting time.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng 'once basic needs are met' để lập luận theo điều kiện, thể hiện tư duy sâu.

packs.title: Cities & Urban Life
packs.title_vi: Thành phố & đời sống đô thị
questions: Why do people move to big cities?
What problems do large cities face?
How can governments reduce traffic congestion?
Will rural areas become empty in the future?
packs.sample: People mainly move to cities in search of better job opportunities and services. However, rapid urbanisation causes problems such as traffic congestion, overcrowding and a lack of affordable housing. One viable solution is to invest heavily in public transport and to create jobs in smaller towns so that growth is spread more evenly.
packs.tips_vi: Trả lời theo cấu trúc: nguyên nhân → vấn đề → giải pháp.

packs.title: Media & Advertising
questions: Do advertisements influence what people buy?
Should advertising aimed at children be banned?
Is social media a reliable source of news?
How has journalism changed?
packs.sample: Definitely. Advertisers study their target audience very carefully and use persuasive techniques to build brand loyalty. I think adverts aimed at young children should be restricted, because kids can't always tell when something is misleading. As for social media, it's fast but not always reliable, since misinformation spreads quickly.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng 'restricted' thay vì 'banned' để thể hiện quan điểm cân bằng.

packs.title: Health & Lifestyle
questions: Why are many people less healthy today than in the past?
Should the government make unhealthy food more expensive?
Is mental health taken seriously enough?
How can people be encouraged to exercise more?
packs.sample: I think the main reason is that many people now lead a sedentary lifestyle – they sit at a desk all day and rely on junk food. A tax on sugary drinks could help, as it has in some countries. Mental health is taken more seriously than before, but there's still a stigma, so schools and workplaces should provide more support.
packs.tips_vi: Dùng ví dụ thực tế (as it has in some countries) để tăng sức thuyết phục.

self_practice: Record yourself answering one Part 1 question for 30 seconds. Listen back and count how many topic words you used.
Choose three expressions from a pack and use each in a sentence about your own life.
Answer a Part 2 cue card for two minutes using a timer. Try to cover all four bullet points.
Paraphrase the question before answering a Part 3 question (e.g. 'Why do people move to cities?' → 'There are several reasons people relocate to urban areas…').
Give a balanced answer: one advantage, one disadvantage and your own opinion.
Replace 'very good' and 'very bad' in your answers with stronger adjectives (outstanding, appalling).
Practise linking ideas with 'As for…', 'On top of that…', 'That said…'.
Describe a photo from your phone in detail for one minute without stopping.
